name: Wireless Device Manager Pro
notes: Paid Pro edition. Multiple devices, favorites, groups, low-battery alerts, dashboard, Cycle Device and capability-gated control. Groups do not auto-connect devices.
blocker: Physical Stream Deck / wireless-device QA is still required. The hosted Windows runner proves compile, tests, Node plugin build, bridge smoke, structural key visuals, validation and packaging but cannot prove the user's Maya X appears in the real Property Inspector or real A2DP/HFP control behavior.
release_gate: locked dependency install and npm audit with 0 vulnerabilities
five Pro profiles: Standard, Mini, XL, Plus and Neo
linked HEADPHONES status/control slot on every bundled Pro profile
x64 and ARM64 self-contained native Windows Bluetooth bridge publish
one-shot bridge snapshot and persistent stdio protocol smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
PackRat Lite Pro Portfolio Audit and Rat Ship Marketplace Routing CI
real Windows Bluetooth hardware matrix before release

profiles.note: Pro profiles expose dedicated device slots, linked headset control, dashboard/group views and Cycle Device. Plus/Neo prioritize ALL DEVICES, CONNECT, CYCLE and GAMING in the 4x2 layout.

upsell.note: Publish Pro first so Lite can rebuild against the exact verified direct Pro Marketplace URL. Do not invent or guess the destination.

final_boundary: Run rat dev wireless-device-manager-pro on the real Stream Deck host. Confirm plugin startup, PI response, Maya X visibility, runtime key rendering, and the QA.md physical capability matrix. If the PI still fails, run the product host probe and use its launch/link/transport/bridge evidence before changing architecture. Do not move to READY_TO_SHIP until the physical matrix passes.
